description: CJ API V2 read-only catalog search, product/variant detail, USD catalog prices and country inventory. Calls require a CJ-Access-Token supplied in memory; no token was available for live authenticated replay.

capabilities.title: Use a valid CJ API V2 access token for catalog reads
capabilities.blocker: The documented endpoints require CJ-Access-Token. No token was supplied in this read-only task; unauthenticated GET returned 401. No account enrollment or token acquisition was attempted.
capabilities.note: This is API-token authorization, not an interactive browser-login flow. See references/commerce-suppliers-contracts.json.

capabilities.title: Search products and collect sell price, category, stock summary and paging
capabilities.blocker: Client request and schema behavior have fixture coverage from the official contract, but a credentialed live catalog search has not run.
capabilities.note: GET /api2.0/v1/product/listV2. The documented sellPrice is USD and is not the same field as direct wholesale pricing. Page and size are bounded to 1-1000 and 1-100.

capabilities.title: Read product details, variant prices, wholesale arrays and country-specific inventory
capabilities.blocker: The documented read endpoint is implemented and fixture-tested; an authenticated live read needs a CJ access token.
capabilities.note: POST /api2.0/v1/product/productDetail/query is a read operation with body {id}. sellprice/variant sell prices are USD. Preserve wholesalePrice arrays without currency conversion because the reviewed array schema does not state their currency. variantInventory distinguishes actual CJ-held stock and virtual factory stock by country.

capabilities.title: Read the CJ product category tree
capabilities.blocker: The documented category endpoint has not been replayed with an access token.

capabilities.title: Add products to a store, submit orders or change account settings
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested read-only supplier product and price collection; store writes, orders, and account changes are outside scope.
